safe_content_feature_requests.title: Onboarding Welcome Tooltips
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players understand controls and objectives instantly without guessing.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Currently, a new player drops straight into a route with zero guidance.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Display clear introductory text prompts at the start of the first session explaining how to move and fight.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Gives explorers and collectors clear visibility over uncollected items, unique route lore, and completion milestones.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Currently, players have no in-game ledger tracking which collectibles (like Gloomcaps or Root Relics) they have found across different routes.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add an in-game collection journal menu tracking route discovery milestones and cosmetic checklists.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Elite Enemy Aggression Modifiers
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Heightens engagement and tests mastery on late-game routes.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: High-difficulty paths currently lack mechanical pressure and density, leading to passive traversal rather than tactical combat.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add dynamic combat encounter modifiers and pack configurations to raise the mastery ceiling.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Weekend Route Coin Multiplier Content Pack
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Helps bridge the currency gap for high-end marketplace items without breaking core balance.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Players saving toward elite cosmetics like the Waypoint Crown experience a sharp drop-off in purchasing power after buying two mid-tier items.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce a temporary content modifier that grants a +10 coin bonus on alternate completion paths to accelerate elite item acquisition.

all_feature_requests.title: Movement Command Validation & Obstacle Input Buffering
all_feature_requests.player_value: Prevents accidental self-damage and frustrating control lockups when players spam or misclick movement keys against obstacles.
all_feature_requests.rationale: Edge-case telemetry shows redundant walk commands attempting to queue against active hazard collisions, aligning with backlog item P3.
all_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Input handling gracefully ignores redundant walk commands against blocking terrain or provides immediate contextual feedback.

observations.evidence: Play trace begins immediately with walk actions on Moss Trail without any introductory tooltips or guidance at step 0.
observations.recommendation: Introduce welcome tooltips or an introductory prompt at step 0 to guide first-time players on initial movement and combat basics.

observations.evidence: Successfully finished Moss Trail and received Moss Trail completion reward (+25 coins).
observations.recommendation: Keep the Moss Trail difficulty 1 route as a welcoming entry point for fresh players.

observations.evidence: Completed Gloomwood Hollow without in-game UI tracking for unique collectibles (Gloomcap, Root Relic) shown in the world state.
observations.recommendation: Implement the Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI to give collectors a visible checklist of items gathered per route.

observations.evidence: Purchased 'trail_cap' for 45 coins leaving 88 coins balance after route completion.
observations.recommendation: Expand cosmetic categorization or add preview modes for hat and trail types to enhance the collecting metagame.

observations.evidence: Played through Frostfang Pass (difficulty 3) and only encountered 2 enemies (Slime, Kobold) total across 12 steps.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy spawn frequencies and density scaling on difficulty 3+ routes to match combat challenger expectations.

observations.evidence: Completed a high-difficulty route (Frostfang Pass, difficulty 3) yielding a flat +25 coins reward with no combat performance bonus.
observations.recommendation: Introduce risk/reward multipliers for flawless or speed-based combat clears on high-difficulty routes.

observations.evidence: After completing Treasure Run and gathering initial coins (totaling 146 gross coins acquired/managed), the player could buy two mid-tier items (Trail Cap at 45 and Moon Hood at 80) but was left with 21 coins, falling short of the elite item threshold ('waypoint_crown' returned 'Not enough coins').
observations.recommendation: Adjust elite cosmetic price points or scale route completion bonuses slightly to smooth out the progression curve between mid-tier and high-tier items.

observations.evidence: Marketplace feedback messages clearly state success ('Purchased and equipped...') and failure ('Not enough coins.'), providing immediate transactional clarity.
observations.recommendation: Maintain the clear purchase feedback messaging format across all future cosmetic additions.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchase of the 'trail_cap' executed successfully via API action, but standard UI navigation lacks explicit keyboard focus rings as noted in the high-contrast UI theme backlog item.
observations.recommendation: Implement prominent, high-contrast visual focus rings for all interactive buttons and menu items to support keyboard-only users.

observations.evidence: Coin collection messages and route completion rewards (+6, +12, +4, +25) are clearly presented in the trace action logs.
observations.recommendation: Ensure on-screen HUD text notifications for currency pickups maintain high font weights and contrast ratios against varied biome backdrops.

observations.evidence: Telemetry and play trace show two consecutive redundant walk actions ('The obstacle blocks walking. Use Jump.') at step 2, causing player health damage (8 damage per hit) before switching to jump commands.
observations.recommendation: Implement input buffering or command validation to prevent redundant movement commands against active hazards from repeatedly draining player HP without state progression.

reports.session_summary: Evaluated the coin flow and marketplace purchasing behavior during a Treasure Run session. The player collected 5 initial coins, completed the route for a +25 coin bonus, and successfully purchased the Trail Cap (45 coins) and Moon Hood (80 coins), leaving 21 coins and failing to afford the elite Waypoint Crown. The current economy balances mid-tier spending well, but highlights a currency wall for elite cosmetics.

observations.evidence: After completing Treasure Run and gathering initial coins (totaling 146 gross coins acquired/managed), the player could buy two mid-tier items (Trail Cap at 45 and Moon Hood at 80) but was left with 21 coins, falling short of the elite item threshold ('waypoint_crown' returned 'Not enough coins').
observations.recommendation: Adjust elite cosmetic price points or scale route completion bonuses slightly to smooth out the progression curve between mid-tier and high-tier items.

observations.evidence: Marketplace feedback messages clearly state success ('Purchased and equipped...') and failure ('Not enough coins.'), providing immediate transactional clarity.
observations.recommendation: Maintain the clear purchase feedback messaging format across all future cosmetic additions.
